faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.body: A few of the things people most often ask. Can't see yours? Just ask us.
faqSection.cta: Still have a question? Contact us

faq.a: Our community is designed for over-50s looking for an easier, low-maintenance lifestyle. Whether you're downsizing, retiring, or simply ready for less upkeep and more living, you're welcome here.

faq.q: How much do the homes cost?
faq.a: Homes in Stage 1 start from $499,000. Prices vary depending on the home design, layout and position within the community.

faq.q: What does home ownership look like here?
faq.a: You own your home outright. It is purchased professionally finished and yours from day one, with no body corporate and no traditional retirement village contract.

faq.q: What does the weekly site fee cover?
faq.a: The weekly site fee helps cover community facilities, gardens, landscaping and common area maintenance, so everyday living stays easy and well looked after.

faq.q: Are there entry or exit fees?
faq.a: No. Unlike many traditional retirement village models, there are no entry or exit fees on the home itself.

faq.q: What facilities are available in the community?
faq.a: Residents can enjoy a heated swimming pool, bowling and croquet greens, gym, private cinema, library, meeting rooms, hobby workshop, community kitchen, residents lounge and a year-round social calendar.
Pet policies can vary, but the community is designed to support a relaxed and welcoming lifestyle. Please contact the team for the latest information on pet suitability.

faq.q: Can I book an inspection or ask about available lots?
faq.a: Yes. You can request a callback, book an inspection, or enquire about available homes and lots directly through the website.
